name: Opportunity Mars Exploration Rover
endReason: A planet-wide dust storm blocked sunlight from its solar panels, and the rover stopped communicating.
kidFact: Opportunity worked for almost 15 years, far longer than its planned 90 days.

story.title: A long Mars adventure
story.text: Opportunity explored Mars for almost 15 years. A huge dust storm blocked sunlight, and its last signal came on June 10, 2018.

whyLeft: The rover used solar power. Dust blocked its sunlight, and it could not send another signal.

quiz.explanation: Dust in the storm blocked sunlight from reaching its solar panels.

photo.alt: A wide panorama taken by a Mars Exploration Rover on Mars.
